1.0.5.en: wifi signal condition now uses numeric comparison

1.0.6.en: Added equality comparison operator to conditions

1.0.7.en: Major stability and compliance improvements: Fixed connection reliability with automatic reconnection, improved flow card grammar, redesigned icons to outlined style, updated app images for better presentation, and addressed all Homey App Store feedback.

1.0.8.en: Fixed app icon visibility: Changed from outlined to filled design for better contrast against the orange background.

1.0.9.en: Critical bug fix: Removed code references to deleted set_power_state action card to prevent app crashes.

1.0.10.en: Fixed UI issues: Target temperature no longer shows when stove is off, removed capability update race conditions that caused flickering, enabled fan speed 5 (auto mode), and improved power level UI updates.

1.0.11.en: Updated app icon to outlined style with thicker strokes for better visibility.

1.0.12.en: Updated app icon to use white outlines for better contrast on orange background.

1.0.13.en: Complete icon redesign: Proper outline icons (960x960) that work in both light and dark mode, and realistic ambient app images showing stove in room setting per Homey guidelines.

1.0.14.en: Icon improvements per Homey verification feedback: Changed strokes from gray to black for better contrast, standardized line widths, and properly centered all icons vertically.

1.0.15.en: Updated icons with thicker lines for improved visibility.

1.1.0.en: Fixes app crashes after settings changes or device removal. The stove now reconnects automatically after an outage and shows as unavailable instead of displaying old values. Manual IP pairing works, and discovery finds running stoves. Changing the IP setting takes effect immediately. Flow fixes: "Stove is in state" now matches; the smoke temperature trigger fires only when the threshold is crossed; "Turn off when temperature reached" is a one-shot that survives restarts; "Any stove turned on/off" now fires.
